verdict.rationale: Obsidian documents a public custom URI protocol for triggering actions such as opening or creating notes. It also publishes a TypeScript plugin API (obsidian-api, including the Vault interface for files and folders) and a headless Sync client aimed at agents and automated workflows. One community user confirms using the API to extract metadata and push metrics to CloudWatch. However, the plugin API runs inside the app rather than letting an external agent drive it, and the URI scheme covers only limited actions, so this is real but constrained programmatic control. Missing for 10: a documented external/remote API (e.g. REST or local server) for driving the app programmatically, evidence of broad action coverage via URI, independent hands-on corroboration of agent-driven control.
